hypothesis: The seed-44 task-balanced adapter's measured completion and arithmetic behaviors depend on specific q/v projection and layer-half deltas rather than only the aggregate adapter norm.
intervention_definition: Set the LoRA B tensor to zero for selected modules in both the learned adapter and its per-module norm-matched random control. Keep all other tensors unchanged and recompute effective delta statistics.

completion_evaluation.primary_outcome: unique-option completion correctness overall, phrase_completion, and sentence_completion separately

uncertainty: Paired family-stratified bootstrap intervals; phrase estimates are exploratory because only six v2 phrase families are in development.
holdout_policy: Do not consume v2 completion confirmation or casegen_v3 arithmetic confirmation. Development pools are already exposed and cannot establish confirmation or promotion.
promotion_policy: No adapter promotion, merging, or Astra-transfer claim from these development ablations.
interpretation_limit: This is an intervention on LoRA module groups. It does not identify individual neurons or prove a general causal mechanism beyond this checkpoint and task set.

arm_mapping.adapter: checkpoint with the preregistered LoRA module group zeroed
arm_mapping.random: norm-matched random checkpoint with the identical module group zeroed
